statement: Broadcom management told the Q3 FY2026 call it has line of sight for fiscal 2028 AI semiconductor revenue to double again to $230 billion.
why: A commitment of this scale from the leading custom-accelerator supplier reprices how much of AI compute spend will bypass merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Custom accelerator revenue at this scale absorbs wafer, packaging and HBM supply and displaces merchant-GPU volume inside the largest buyers, while confirming total AI compute demand is still expanding.

evidence.excerpt: In 2028, we expect the trajectory of growth to continue. We have line of sight for fiscal 2028 AI semiconductor revenue growth to again double to $230 billion.

confidence.basis: Secondary transcript coverage from one outlet; the figure does not appear in Broadcom's filed 8-K exhibit and no official transcript was available.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 34.8 -> 230.0 (tol 1%); sources: Broadcom Inc. (SEC EDGAR 8-K Exhibit 99.1), Investing.com
